requirements.content:
# Requirements: Stripe Webhook Handling

**Status:** APPROVED
**Profile:** api

## Core Requirements

### REQ-003.1 — Signature Verification
The webhook receiver must verify Stripe HMAC signatures using the configured webhook secret before parsing the payload body.

### REQ-003.2 — Idempotent Event Processing
The service must store incoming `event.id` values with a 24-hour TTL in cache to reject duplicate transmissions.

### REQ-003.3 — Asynchronous Queue Dispatch
Events must be enqueued into the background processing queue within 200ms of receipt, returning an HTTP 200 status immediately.

design.content:
# Design: Stripe Webhook Handling

**Status:** APPROVED

## Architecture Sequence

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  Stripe ->> Webhook Handler: POST /webhooks/stripe (Signed Event)
  Webhook Handler ->> Crypto Verifier: Validate Signature (HMAC SHA-256)
  Crypto Verifier -->> Webhook Handler: Valid Signature
  Webhook Handler ->> Cache: Check Event ID (Idempotency Key)
  Cache -->> Webhook Handler: Key not found (First seen)
  Webhook Handler ->> Event Queue: Enqueue 'invoice.payment_succeeded'
  Webhook Handler -->> Stripe: 200 OK (Event Acknowledged)
```

## Security Boundaries
- Never trust raw unverified JSON.
- Read raw request buffer before json parsing to calculate hash signature.
